output.body: Take adding 1+2+...+n: define sum(n) = n + sum(n-1), with base case sum(1) = 1 because there is nothing smaller to hand off. So sum(3) = 3 + sum(2) = 3 + 2 + sum(1), and the known value sum(1) = 1 stops the chain. Factorial has the same structure, with fact(n) = n * fact(n-1).
